headline: Defense Stocks Shine in Europe as US Munitions Decline, Leonardo Rises
summary: European defence shares rose as geopolitical tensions persisted and signals emerged about the need to replenish Western arsenals. Leonardo was among the gainers, while US munitions demand declined.
why: Leonardo is an Italian defence and aerospace group, and European defence stocks react to government spending plans and geopolitical risk.

impacts.name: Leonardo
impacts.why: The article states Leonardo rose as defence stocks gained on rearmament signals.
